{{Top|leg}}
'''Cartilage''' is a type of tissue found in some [[Species/Legends|animals]]. The [[Mammal/Legends|mammalian]] [[Galoomp/Legends|Galoomps]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] had loose cartilage in their tail knobs, which could be rattled to warn of approaching danger.<ref name="Wildlife">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref>
